verse.verse_3: And when the hills are moved,
verse.verse_4: And when the camels big with young are abandoned,
verse.verse_5: And when the wild beasts are herded together,
verse.verse_8: And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked
verse.verse_9: For what sin she was slain,
verse.verse_10: And when the pages are laid open,
verse.verse_11: And when the sky is torn away,
verse.verse_13: And when the Garden is brought nigh,
verse.verse_14: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready.
verse.verse_15: Oh, but I call to witness the planets,
verse.verse_16: The stars which rise and set,
verse.verse_19: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger,
verse.verse_20: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,
verse.verse_22: And your comrade is not mad.
verse.verse_23: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.
verse.verse_24: And he is not avid of the Unseen.
verse.verse_25: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned.
verse.verse_27: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,
verse.verse_28: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.
verse.verse_29: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.
